document.name: @6a7cbdbe13345b88f7121187: NetBox Inventory Sync - Orchestrator (runCode, Enable Query)
document.description: Loads devices from NetBox into Itential Inventory Manager via the inventory-loader IAG5 service, with per-vendor secret mapping done in a runCode Python task, and a ServiceNow change record. New, separate asset -- not a modification of the original orchestrator. Uses the Automation Studio "Enable Query" decorator feature to inline-query a nested field directly on the consuming task, eliminating a separate query task.

a006.summary: Map NetBox Devices to Inventory Records (Python)

incoming.code:
import sys
import json

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
devices = data.get('devices', [])

CISCO_USER = "$SECRET_devices/ios_cat8k $KEY_username"
CISCO_PASS = "$SECRET_devices/ios_cat8k $KEY_password"
STUB_USER = "$SECRET_devices/TODO_UNMAPPED_VENDOR $KEY_username"
STUB_PASS = "$SECRET_devices/TODO_UNMAPPED_VENDOR $KEY_password"

mapped = []
for d in devices:
    device_type = d.get('device_type') or {}
    manufacturer = (device_type.get('manufacturer') or {}).get('name')
    model = device_type.get('model')
    primary_ip4 = d.get('primary_ip4') or {}
    host = primary_ip4.get('address')
    is_cisco = bool(manufacturer) and 'cisco' in manufacturer.lower()

    mapped.append({
        "name": d.get('name'),
        "netbox_id": d.get('id'),
        "manufacturer": manufacturer,
        "model": model,
        "itential_host": host,
        "itential_platform": manufacturer,
        "itential_driver": "netmiko",
        "itential_user": CISCO_USER if is_cisco else STUB_USER,
        "itential_password": CISCO_PASS if is_cisco else STUB_PASS
    })

print(json.dumps(mapped))
